items: Add per-component axial extents (id, axialStart, axialEnd, cg, mass) to the provider stability DTO from the existing rollup, making a provider result self-sufficient and removing the second aggregate_mass call.

Share one rollup implementation between stability (crates/astraea-core/src/aero.rs:662 private copy) and aggregate_mass (crates/astraea-core/src/mass.rs:570); the three-preset parity test then guards one source instead of two.
upstream_follow_up_option_E.reason_not_done: Brief forbids crates/ edits in this lane; recorded for the engine backlog.

deliberately_not_done: No changes to the Aero breakdown rows or its unavailable wording; beta rows stay empty and honest.
No marker substitution: beta CG/CP are the provider's own totals.
No retry of a failed geometry rollup until the entry is evicted or the vehicle changes (same policy as stability errors).
No acceptance-register or manifest change; this lane has no register row.
limitations: During a model switch the last ready snapshot keeps its own breakdown markers until the new result lands (established keep-last behaviour); on a failed rollup the last good shape+markers pairing stays.
One aggregate_mass call is made per landed provider stability result even when no viewport is mounted; it is cheap, cached and coalesced with stability.
